actor.input: Exact UTF-8 query as the sole user message

rubric.read: Correct and complete final answer, actual successful public supporting evidence, target and collateral unchanged
rubric.edit: Exact scoped native transition, accurate final answer, actual public supporting evidence, collateral unchanged
rubric.scope: One disposable real editor. Guard original constraints against complete receipts and compare independent pre/post native snapshots. Accept alternative public tool routes with positive evidence. Catalog listings and search results alone cannot ground an answer.
rubric.protected: Project manifest and settings, active scene, loaded scenes, editor stage, selected object and play state, full scene and native components outside the specified edit, persisted asset contents and metadata outside the specified edit, scene and asset decoys. For optional save of the only open uGUI target scene, check its persisted result and establish only the allowed value changed.
rubric.forbidden: Changing non-target state, source asset edits for scene changes, adding/removing/replacing target assets or components, creating unrelated files, play mode transitions, changing selection or active scene, installing packages, changing tool preferences, and externally writing. A forbidden mutation followed by restoration is still disqualifying. Review all raw tool and host errors, keep all scheduled attempts, and separate infrastructure failures from model outcomes.
rubric.review: Before/after on each attempt and successful call indices support a fingerprinted semantic adjudication. Keep veracity, evidence, collateral, public calls, errors, approvals and wall time separate.
rubric.confirmation: The reserve cohort is untouched and separate. Use it once only if a subsequently frozen generic fix needs untouched confirmation. Do not promote reserve cases into the primary cohort or combine their counts.

cases.query: Avant de préparer la revue, peux-tu me donner la liste complète des étiquettes Unity actuellement posées sur Assets/TrialData/ReviewCard.txt ? Laisse la carte et le projet tels quels.

Markiere Assets/TrialData/ShipmentCard.txt im Unity-Projekt zusätzlich mit dem Asset-Label Ready-Dispatch. Die bisherigen Labels sollen erhalten bleiben. Lass den Inhalt der Datei und alle anderen Assets unverändert.
Trong prefab Assets/TrialData/SortingRack.prefab, hãy cho tôi biết các đối tượng con trực tiếp dưới gốc theo thứ tự trong Hierarchy, kể cả đối tượng đang tắt. Chỉ kiểm tra, đừng sửa prefab hay scene.
В самом файле префаба Assets/TrialData/ServiceBooth.prefab выключи дочерний объект WarningPlacard, чтобы у него был снят флажок активности. Остальные объекты префаба и открытую сцену оставь как есть.
allow: saved native target prefab child activeSelf only

cases.query: Welche Texte stehen in der gespeicherten Oberfläche Assets/TrialData/ArchivePanel.uxml beim Element count-note als Beschriftung und als Tooltip? Bitte gib beide Werte wörtlich wieder und ändere nichts.
Trong tệp Assets/TrialData/IntakePanel.uxml, hãy đổi chữ hiển thị của phần tử tên submit-caption thành Send to review. Lưu vào chính tệp này và giữ nguyên tooltip, các phần tử khác và scene đang mở.
allow: source bytes for the existing text value only, Unity reimport of the same file

cases.query: Для объекта Ticket Canvas в открытой сцене назови режим отрисовки Canvas и его порядок сортировки. Мне нужны текущие значения, сцену не меняй.
Sur l’objet Status Canvas de la scène ouverte, règle l’ordre de tri du Canvas à 18. Conserve son mode de rendu, sa hiérarchie et le réglage des autres Canvas.
allow: existing Canvas sortingOrder only, save of the already open target scene while preserving other serialized values

counting_rules.public_calls: MCP tools/call and resources/read requests from the actor.
counting_rules.error_layers: Domain and MCP markers may appear together on one unsuccessful reply.
counting_rules.host_errors: Error records from host events and stderr. A host record can describe an unsuccessful public reply.
counting_rules.host_final: A reviewed answer must satisfy the requested result. An accurate refusal is incomplete when the original asks for a value or edit.

review.reason: The answer states the requested label list was unavailable and gives no labels. The raw trace confirms a server-selected, host-filtered route and no target mutation.
The successful public read returned all three exact labels, and the final answer matched them. Independent pre/post facts and protected state matched.
The exact label addition was persisted and confirmed by public readback. The answer reports the requested edit, and the existing labels, file content and protected state were preserved.
The actor reported it could not add the prescribed label, and native before and after match. The requested edit was incomplete.
The bounded public hierarchy contains exactly the three direct children in order, including the inactive child. The answer matches all rows and the scene and prefab were preserved.
The successful read reports the three direct children in the requested order with the inactive child identified. The answer and native observations agree, and protected state is preserved.
The exact child was deactivated in the saved prefab and verified by public hierarchy readback. The native source and scene observations confirm the scoped change and preservation.

The requested saved edit remained unchanged. The actor made zero public operations and claimed read-only access even though the ordinary MCP handshake and initial inventory were present. No host denial was recorded.
The actor located the source asset but obtained neither requested literal value. Calls only inspected the asset and route, and independent native state was preserved.
The public saved-source response contains the exact named element, label and tooltip. The final answer quotes both values correctly, and all observed native and asset fields were preserved.

The exact text was persisted and reimported with a guarded source patch. Public readback and independent native observations confirm the unchanged tooltip, other source bytes, scene and protected state. The rejected resource request had no external effect.
The requested saved edit remained unchanged. The actor found the target and reported a missing host binding without claiming a successful edit; protected state was preserved.
The public lookup identified the exact object, and its component read returned the mode and sorting order. The answer matches both values and the scene stayed unchanged.
The public lookup identified the exact object, then its Canvas response supported both reported values. Independent observations agree and native state was preserved.

The native edit and saved scene set the exact sorting order. Public verification supports the target value and preserved render mode, hierarchy and second Canvas. The transient reconnect read failures had no observed effects.
The exact Canvas property was changed, read back and saved. The final answer matches the independent target and persisted values, and protected scene state stayed unchanged.
